cards.card_text: But Jesus also says the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
cards.verse_text: But the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
cards.snippet: …be thrown into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

cards.card_text: Jesus says the angels will throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
cards.verse_text: And they will throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
cards.snippet: …throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

cards.card_text: Jesus says there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth there.
cards.verse_text: and throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
cards.snippet: …throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

cards.card_text: Then the king tells the servants, "Tie him hand and foot, and throw him into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth." This part is heavy, friend.
cards.verse_text: Then the king told the servants, ‘Tie him hand and foot, and throw him into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
cards.snippet: …throw him into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

cards.card_text: Jesus says the master will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
cards.verse_text: Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
cards.snippet: …him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

cards.card_text: Out there, there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
cards.verse_text: And throw that worthless servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
cards.snippet: …worthless servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

cards.card_text: Then Jesus says there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when the ones knocking see who's inside the kingdom of God, while they themselves are thrown out.
cards.verse_text: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, but you yourselves are thrown out.
cards.snippet: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets…
